title: Product updates page
when: The user wants a public page that lists product updates or release notes for customers.
prompt:
Goal: A scannable timeline of changes written for customers, not for developers.
Steps:
1. One h1 and a one line intro; optional filter by type (New, Improved, Fixed) as buttons.
2. Each update: date in a time element, a type label in text, a title with the user benefit, two lines of detail, a link to docs.
3. Newest first; group by month when there are many.
4. Anchor ids on each update so they can be linked.
5. Subscribe or feed link at the end if the user has one.
Quality bar:
- Each title says what the customer can now do.
- Labels are text, not only color.
- Dates are unambiguous.
Pitfalls:
- Internal ticket numbers or jargon.
- Walls of text.
- Duplicate anchor ids.
Verify:
- [ ] Updates sorted newest first.
- [ ] time elements with datetime.
- [ ] Unique ids.
- [ ] Filter buttons have type.
Output: updates.html, style.css and an optional filter script.

examples.input: página de novidades do meu app
examples.output: h1 What is new, 6 updates with dates and New or Fixed labels, filter buttons
